title: Afterword to the Correspondence between Luria and Piaget
abstract: The correspondence between Artur Luria and Jean Piaget began in 1929, following their meeting at the 9th International Congress of Psychology in New Haven. This article examines the history of their academic and personal relationship, their joint projects involving Lev Vygotsky which never came to fruition, and the history of the English translation of “Thinking and Speech”, with a foreword by Piaget.
